summary: TerraCascade is an Earth intelligence platform built around NISAR’s radar observations. It helps students, researchers, and local planners explore how Earth’s surface changes and what to watch next. The project uses clearly labeled illustrative data to guide users through three steps: see a change on the map, understand the evidence behind it, and explore what could happen if the trend continues.
details: TerraCascade is an Earth intelligence platform built around NISAR’s radar observations. Through SEE → UNDERSTAND → ANTICIPATE, it helps users explore surface changes, understand environmental connections, and investigate what may happen next. The completed platform will integrate AI models into its TerraCast engine to support forecasting and scenario analysis, while the AI-powered Ask Terra assistant will explain observations, projections, and uncertainty using traceable evidence. Interactive maps and scenario comparisons will highlight areas deserving further monitoring. The current prototype uses clearly labeled illustrative data, with AI integration planned for the completed version.
